competences.description: Attacks with claws and stuns the enemy if the attack lands as a Critical Hit. The damage increases according to the Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a body slam and weakens their Attack Power and Defense for 2 turns. The damage is proportionate to your Defense.

Increases Defense by 50% and recovers 20% of the damage inflicted to the enemies as HP. Your attack will always land as a Critical Hit against the target who has lower Defense than yours. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Attack will always land as a Critical Hit
effets.note: If self DEF greater than target

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
